canonical_title: Thomson Reuters expands commercialization plans for its proprietary Thomson LLM
treatment: Thomson officially launched on 2026-08-24. Reinclude only for public API or licensing terms, named sovereign-AI deployments, material new product integration, independent/reproducible benchmark results, meaningful model/version changes, or material economics/cost disclosures beyond the launch details already recorded.
known_facts: Thomson Reuters had disclosed the existence and commercialization direction of its proprietary Thomson LLM before the 2026-08-24 official launch.

On 2026-08-24 Thomson Reuters officially launched Thomson, its first proprietary in-house LLM, built from a strong open-source foundation and specialized with proprietary professional content and subject-matter expertise.
Thomson Reuters said it invested $40 million across talent and compute to train Thomson and that the model has so far been trained on less than 10% of Thomson Reuters content.
The first deployment is inside Tabular Analysis in CoCounsel Legal; CoCounsel remains multi-model and will use other leading models where appropriate.
Thomson Reuters is making a small version of Thomson available as an open-weight model on Hugging Face for academic and non-commercial use to support external validation.
Thomson Reuters plans to extend Thomson across legal and tax products and continues to plan sovereign-AI options.
Earlier Q2 disclosures said about 32% of underlying contract value relied on generative AI, up from 30% in Q1 2026.
reinclude_only_if: Thomson gains a public API, commercial licensing terms, or explicit external deployment terms.
Thomson Reuters publishes reproducible benchmarks or independent evaluations materially changing the performance interpretation.
A named sovereign-AI customer deployment or material external commercialization agreement is announced.
Westlaw, CoCounsel, Checkpoint, or another major product materially changes model architecture, availability, cost, latency, or quality because of Thomson.
A new Thomson model/version or materially broader open-weight release is published.
notes: The 2026-08-24 event is a FOLLOW_UP because the model and commercialization plan were already covered on 2026-08-05; the hard delta is official launch, initial CoCounsel deployment, $40M development disclosure, and a small open-weight release for academic/non-commercial validation.
